Title: Public preview: ExpressRoute Metro for High Resiliency

Body.Content:
Announcing the public preview of ExpressRoute Metro, a high-resiliency configuration designed to offer multi-site redundancy. With ExpressRoute Metro, you can benefit from a dual-homed configuration that enables diverse connections to two distinct edge sites within a city. This enhances reliability and uptime for your conectivity from on-premises to your critical workloads in Azure. Learn more about ExpressRoute Metro.
 
The preview will initially feature the Metro architecture in the locations listed and will include support for ExpressRoute Circuits and ExpressRoute Direct (10G & 100G).

  • Amsterdam
  • Singapore
  • Zurich 

With the launch of this solution, ExpressRoute now offers three tiers of resiliency - Standard, High, and Maximum - empowering customers to configure their Circuits and Direct ports according to their preferred level of resilience. Learn more about ExpressRoute Resiliency.
